top_reviews.title: Works well, can be washed and cleaned easily, doesn’t create dust
top_reviews.body: These cleaning cloths work very well and clean up very well.  They are a good thickness, texture and size and are easy to use.  They are a good price because they last a LONG time and don’t wear out with repeated washings.I used one yellow cloth to clean very dirty window frames and, as you can see in the last picture, they clean up like they are brand new!!  All black marks are gone!  I washed the cloth in the sink with hot water and liquid soap after each cleaning and it looks new!  Also NO dust, particles etc. like I get with paper towels because of the microfiber material.I also use a different Siga cloth to clean my kitchen counter.  It’s so much better than a sponge!I use different color cloths for different purposes so I don’t get mixed up about what I used when.  Highly recommend!

top_reviews.title: Omgosh NO streaks
top_reviews.body: I’m amazed not one streak 1st & 2nd pics are inside top half of my French doors, 3rd pic is inside my front door looking out (the haze is my outside white door screen to keep put bigs) 4th picture is my door open, as you can see NO streaks and only sprayed gently once inside glass & outside. These microfiber rags are amazing, I did my bathroom & over my kitchen sink mirrors & could not believe how clean with no streaks!I’ve been dealing with streaks since I moved away from home as a young woman, I’m very picky so I’d go over & over years with paper towels then I switched to Viva paper towels, it was better but still had some streaks, then I changed to Walmart brand of spray glass cleaner, better but some little streaking that really showed up after a few days. Shoot, then I’d clean them again, yesrs ago I used white vinegar and water one part V to 2 parts water & newspaper (which cleaned pretty good) on a spray bottle but that got my hands so full of ink! Ick! So figured I was just doomed to be cleaning my windows & mirrors at least once a week!! Just got kinda use to it & hated it, but I’m like Opra Winfrey, her pickiness - like my toilet paper has to be rolling towards me and not away from me even when I go visit somebody’s home if I use their bathroom, I will turn their toilet paper around can’t stand crooked pictures either no matter where I’m at. I will get up and go straighten them, I don’t know my daughter says I got OCD or whatever and I told her no I just want things neat and clean by the way I don’t have to spend a whole day cleaning the house see something dirty go take care of it right then and there,  save so much time!Anyway, don’t ask me how I stumbled over this microfiber rags, but sure glad I did as I am 75 years old it’s not as if I don’t know how to clean a damn house! But I sure rather be playing with my doglets or watching TV.I really did not have high expectations, but I couldn’t wait for them to arrive so I could try them out just to see if the Amazon feedback was even worth reading!I’m here to tell you ‘YES’ it was!!! I’m hoping in a few days that streaks don’t show up, oh BTW Great Value spray glass cleaner even tho it’s cheap is an amazing product better than Windex any day, but what has sealed the deal with me is these microfiber cleaning cloths and I will wash them by hand to make sure they do not pick up any lint, which would happen if you washed them in a load with other items!So just FYI these microfiber cleaning clothes are wonderful I’m going to use one to see how they are on dusting my furniture.**add on a week later than above feedback, even my wood furniture shines & I see NO dust left behind!So far I’m totally pleased & recommend these! Try them you’ll agree!

top_reviews.title: Gentle, Effective, and Lint-Free — Perfect for CPAP and Distiller Care
top_reviews.body: I recently started using the MR.SIGA Microfiber Cleaning Cloths to help maintain my CPAP equipment and clean my water distiller, and I couldn’t be happier with the results.These cloths are soft, durable, and truly streak-free, which is important when cleaning delicate surfaces like my CPAP mask and humidifier chamber. They don’t leave behind lint or residue, and they’re gentle enough not to scratch any parts. I also use them to wipe down my distiller after each use, and they handle mineral buildup and water spots beautifully.What I love most is how absorbent and quick-drying they are. I can use them multiple times before needing to wash, and they hold up well in the laundry without losing their softness or shape. Plus, the pack comes with plenty of cloths, so I always have a fresh one ready.For the price, they offer great value — especially considering how versatile they are. Whether it’s for CPAP maintenance, kitchen cleaning, or general household use, these microfiber towels are a reliable go-to.Highly recommend for anyone looking to keep their CPAP gear and water distiller clean and in top condition!
